answer_1.quote: Data-to-Text aims at generating natural language descriptions from structured data ...

answer_2.quote: We report BLEU scores as well as PARENT (precision, recall and F1) scores.

answer_4.quote: Our human annotators are ... Annotators are shown a randomly selected table, together with the corresponding descriptions ... Annotators are asked, for each sentence, to score its fluency (as Fluent, Mostly fluent, or Not fluent) factualness (likewise), and coverage.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators score each generated sentence on fluency, factualness, and coverage.
